ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels. The central and medial regions are dominated by low-intensity values, while high-intensity pixels are concentrated on the lateral distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering the central fluke and proximal lobes. High-contrast white mottling and streaking are localized on the far left and right distal tips. Transition zones show grey-scale gradient mottling between the solid black center and white periphery.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 75 degrees. The notch vertex is sharply defined at the junction of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. The lobes exhibit variable peak amplitudes, with more pronounced, jagged protrusions on the inner-half of both lobes and finer serrations towards the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the mid-lobe before reaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring-like scars (rosettes) are visible. Specifically, a large rosette is located on the mid-inner left lobe, and a cluster of smaller rosettes is visible on the inner-right lobe near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear rake marks and scratches are detected across both lobes, with higher density and longer length on the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization is visible on the extreme tips of both lobes, appearing as high-intensity, textured clusters. Multiple white circular depigmentation spots corresponding to old parasite or barnacle attachment sites are distributed across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The far left distal tip exhibits a jagged, heavily scarred profile with more substantial barnacle buildup compared to the right tip.
